result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 5 (Public Safety, Morals and Welfare), covering grocery price-marking penalties, health care facility/place of worship/school buffer zones, and noise limits, with no residential rental provisions in this part.
result.notes: No rules in the six in-scope categories appear in this part. The text covers grocery item pricing (Art. 2.5), miscellaneous police regulations, and the Div. 10 buffer-zone and noise rules for health care facilities, places of worship and schools. Although the source URL slug refers to a division on anti-competitive automated rent price fixing (SDMC 98.1103), the text of that provision is not included in this part, and per the hard rules no rule may be output from the URL alone.
